thesis: The speaker argues that the hedge fund industry has transitioned from being viewed as a source of return-enhancing access to the world's best investment minds to becoming a more institutionalized sector focused on risk management and diversification. This shift has resulted in the average hedge fund becoming less attractive compared to the perception of the early 2000s.
